main_text.l: cludit: Ergo laude dignus est. Hic est secundus Syl-

l.i: logismus practicus, specialis ille. Hunc Syllogismum
specialem in mente Hectoris secuta est lætitia, quæ
ipsius animum in gravissimis periculis non parum le-
niebat, imò liberabat adeò, ut mori pro patriâ jam
non pertimuerit. Nam cùm à vate Polydamante ad-
moneretur, ne bellum contra Græcos iniret, respon-dit:

main_text.l: Εἷς οἰωνὸς ἄριστος[?], ἀμύνεσθαι[?] περὶ πάτρης.

l.i: Adeò præstans ille heros conscientiâ facti fretus, se ad-
versus ærumnas in periculis pro defendendâ patriâ
susceptis erexit. Nam cùm vates volatum avium si-
gnificare triστem eventum nunciaret, Hector animo-
sè respondit: sive dextrorsum aves ortum versus, sive
sinistrorsum ad occasum volent,

main_text.l: Ἡμεῖς δὴ μεγάλοιο Διὸς πειθώμεθα βουλῇ. Consilium Jovis appellans impetum animi heroicum,

l.i: quo ad rem praeclarè & honestè gerendam impelleba-

main_text.l: tur. Non enim putabat ullum tempus esse, quo ea,

l.i: quae honesta sunt, non sint facienda, præsertim cùm
salus patriæ agitur. Nam juxta Euripidis sententiam, τὸ καλὸν φίλον ἀεί.
suppeditavit: Turpissima facta gravissimis pœnis sunt
digna. Lex naturæ formavit hanc minorem: Incestus
cum matre concubitus & parricidiū sunt turpissima
facta. τὸ [?] conclusit: Ergo incestus cum ma-
tre concubitus & parricidium dignissima sunt gravissi-
mis pœnis. Hic est Syllogismus practicus primus, adhuc
generalis: quem statim sequitur specialis, in quo συλ-
λήψεως resumit conclusionem Syllogismi generalis,
nicē-

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ἄριστος" and "ἀμύνεσθαι" in the first Greek line are partly obscured by print damage. The Greek in the last line is copied as seen, accents included. Italic and roman type were judged from the scan. The word "tristem" in the Latin line above has a letter that is not fully clear; it is read as "tristem", i.e. triste, with the mark [?] applied if the reading is doubtful. The Greek word after "Rursus" is read as συλλήψις with doubt. The Greek word after "minorem" and the Greek word in the last line are not fully legible, so they are marked [?]. The abbreviation on "parricidiū" is doubtful. The last word "nicē-" is read with doubt at the line end.
